rules: Any Pokemon that faints is considered dead and must be released or put in the PC permanently.
You can only catch the first Pokemon encountered in each area.
No healing items can be used in battle (potions, heals, etc.). Held items are allowed.
Gym Level Cap: Your Pokemon cannot exceed the highest level of the Gym Leader's Pokemon before challenging that Gym Leader.
Elite Four Level Cap: Before entering the Elite Four, your Pokemon cannot exceed level 55. This cap is based on Drake's highest-level Pokemon and applies to all four Elite Four battles.
Champion Level Cap: Before challenging Champion Wallace, your Pokemon cannot exceed level 58.
